mapper.sql: c.complaint_id as complaintId, c.member_id as memberId, m.member_name as memberName, m.user_id as userId, m.email, m.phone, c.title, c.content, c.complaint_type as complaintType, c.priority, c.status, c.station_id as stationId, c.charger_id as chargerId, c.station_name as stationName, c.charger_name as chargerName, c.notify_email as notifyEmail, c.notify_sms as notifySms, c.notify_site as notifySite, c.assigned_department_id as assignedDepartmentId, d.department_name as assignedDepartmentName, c.assigned_employee_id as assignedEmployeeId, am.member_name as assignedEmployeeName, c.ai_summary as aiSummary, c.admin_memo as adminMemo, c.admin_memo as answerContent, lf.fault_id as linkedFaultId, lf.status as linkedFaultStatus, c.created_at as createdAt, c.updated_at as updatedAt, c.closed_at as closedAt

join app_member m on c.member_id = m.member_id left join department d on c.assigned_department_id = d.department_id left join employee e on c.assigned_employee_id = e.employee_id left join app_member am on e.member_id = am.member_id left join lateral ( select f.fault_id, f.status from fault_report f where f.complaint_id = c.complaint_id order by f.fault_id desc limit 1 ) lf on true
mapper.insert: insert into complaint ( member_id, title, content, complaint_type, priority, status, station_id, charger_id, station_name, charger_name, notify_email, notify_sms, notify_site, ai_summary, created_at ) values ( #{memberId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{complaintType}, #{priority}, '접수', #{stationId}, #{chargerId}, #{stationName}, #{chargerName}, #{notifyEmail}, #{notifySms}, #{notifySite}, #{aiSummary}, current_timestamp )
mapper.select:
select
from complaint c
where c.member_id = #{memberId} order by c.created_at desc

select count(*) as total, count(*) filter (where c.status in ('접수', '확인중', '배정', '처리중')) as pending, count(*) filter ( where c.complaint_type ilike '%고장%' or c.complaint_type ilike '%파손%' or c.content ilike '%고장%' or c.content ilike '%충전이 안%' or c.content ilike '%작동%' or c.ai_summary ilike '%고장%' or c.ai_summary ilike '%장애%' or lf.fault_id is not null ) as facilityFault, count(*) filter (where c.status = '완료') as completed from complaint c

select h.history_id as historyId, h.complaint_id as complaintId, h.employee_id as employeeId, m.member_name as employeeName, h.before_status as beforeStatus, h.after_status as afterStatus, h.action_type as actionType, h.memo, h.created_at as createdAt from complaint_history h left join employee e on h.employee_id = e.employee_id left join app_member m on e.member_id = m.member_id where h.complaint_id = #{complaintId} order by h.created_at asc
mapper.update: update complaint set status = #{status}, admin_memo = coalesce(#{adminMemo}, admin_memo), updated_at = current_timestamp, closed_at = case when #{closed} = true then current_timestamp else closed_at end where complaint_id = #{complaintId}
update complaint set status = '완료', admin_memo = #{answerContent}, updated_at = current_timestamp, closed_at = current_timestamp where complaint_id = #{complaintId}
update complaint set assigned_department_id = #{assignedDepartmentId}, assigned_employee_id = #{assignedEmployeeId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where complaint_id = #{complaintId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from fault_report where complaint_id = #{complaintId} and status not in ('취소')
mapper.insert: insert into fault_report ( complaint_id, station_id, charger_id, fault_type, title, description, severity, status, source_type, reported_at, created_at, updated_at ) select c.complaint_id, c.station_id, c.charger_id, #{faultType}, #{title}, #{description}, case when c.priority = 'HIGH' then 'HIGH' else 'NORMAL' end, '접수', '민원', current_timestamp, current_timestamp, current_timestamp from complaint c where c.complaint_id = #{complaintId} and c.station_id is not null and c.charger_id is not null
mapper.update: update charger ch set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp, last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp from complaint c where c.charger_id = ch.charger_id and c.complaint_id = #{complaintId}
mapper.select: select fault_id from fault_report where complaint_id = #{complaintId} order by fault_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into complaint_history ( complaint_id, employee_id, before_status, after_status, action_type, memo, created_at ) values ( #{complaintId}, #{employeeId}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{actionType}, #{memo}, current_timestamp )
mapper.select: select employee_id from employee where member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
select user_type from app_member where member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
